Advise people with impetigo, and their parents or carers if appropriate, about good hygiene measures to reduce the spread of impetigo to other areas of the body and to other people.

snippets.text:
Advice to reduce the spread of impetigo
Why the committee made the recommendation
Recommendation 1.1.1
The committee agreed, based on its experience, that good hygiene measures help reduce the spread of impetigo, both to other areas of the body and to other people. The committee noted that resources are available with further information (see the
management of impetigo in NICE's clinical knowledge summary on impetigo
).
